item.title: Pope laments violence enveloping Peru as he ministers to far-flung former flock

item.title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations as authorities investigate
item.description: Authorities have found a bomb near an ethanol plant in central Illinois, leading to evacuations. The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria.

item.title: Deb Haaland breaks political barriers as Native women in her home community face hurdles
item.description: Deb Haaland is set to become the first Native American woman governor of a U.S. state. But some women in Haaland's home community of Laguna Pueblo say they are swimming upstream in tribal politics.
